definitions: A tube of metal, plastic, or other material used to convey water, gas, oil, or other fluid substances.
The windpipe or vocal cords of a person or animal.
A bagpipe or set of bagpipes.
The exhaust system of a motor vehicle.
A person's lungs or respiratory system.
examples: The pipes burst during the cold snap.
He has a good set of pipes for singing.
The sound of the pipes carried across the glen.
The car needed new exhaust pipes.
He was out of breath, his pipes struggling.
